overview: B2B platform that replaces 50+ daily phone calls with a real-time dashboard for Argentine frigoríficos to discover cattle lots from connected consignatarias, place digital bids, negotiate counter-offers, and manage procurement. MVP scope: Live Supply Feed, Digital Bidding, and Company Profiles. Shared Supabase backend with consignatarias.com.ar, separate Next.js frontend deployed on Vercel. Spanish-only UI, phone OTP auth, mobile-first design.
goals: Enable frigoríficos to discover available cattle lots in real-time instead of making 30-50 phone calls/day
Provide digital bidding with counter-offer negotiation workflow replacing verbal negotiations
Build frigorífico company profiles and consignatario directory for marketplace trust
Reduce procurement time by 70% (from 4-6 hours/day to under 30 minutes)
Create foundation for future modules (DTE automation, Payment Hub, Scorecards, Analytics)
nonGoals: No payment processing, escrow, or factoring in V1 (future Payment Hub module)
No DTE/SENASA document automation in V1 (future DocCenter module)
No supplier scorecards or historical yield tracking in V1 (future Quality module)
No analytics or reporting dashboard in V1 (future Analytics module)
No EUDR/Hilton compliance tracking in V1 (future Enterprise module)
No consignataria-side features (handled by existing consignatarias.com.ar)
No internationalization — Spanish only, no i18n framework needed
No WhatsApp Business API notifications in V1 (future enhancement)
No pricing tiers or billing in V1 — all users get full MVP features during Programa Pionero pilot
successMetrics: Frigorífico user can view available lots and place a bid within 3 minutes of first login
Bid counter-offer negotiation completes in under 5 round-trips
Real-time lot updates appear in feed within 2 seconds of consignataria posting
5+ frigoríficos onboarded and actively bidding during 90-day Programa Pionero pilot
npm run lint and npm run typecheck pass with zero errors on every story
openQuestions: How does consignatarias.com.ar post lots? Direct Supabase insert from their app or via shared API?
Should lot pricing support dual currency (ARS + USD) or ARS-only in V1?
What is the default lot expiration policy? 24h, 48h, or manual expiration by consignatario?
Should frigoríficos see how many competing bids exist on a lot (transparency vs. privacy)?
Domain strategy: frigorificos.consignatarias.com.ar vs. frigoconnect.com.ar vs. other?

stack.database: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Realtime + Auth + Storage) — shared project with consignatarias.com.ar
stack.realtime: Supabase Realtime (WebSocket subscriptions on lots and bids tables)

importFormat.description: Lots are created by consignatarias via consignatarias.com.ar (shared Supabase database). No external import needed on the frigorífico side. Seed data uses the same lot schema for development.

rules: Only users with role 'comprador' or 'admin' can place bids
A lot can receive multiple bids from different frigoríficos simultaneously
A frigorífico can only have one active (pending) bid per lot — must withdraw previous bid to rebid
A bid can be countered by the consignatario, creating a new bid linked via parent_bid_id
When a bid is accepted: lot.status → 'sold', all other pending bids on that lot are auto-rejected
Lot feed shows only lots with status 'available' or 'under_negotiation'
Lots expire automatically when current time > expires_at — status changes to 'expired' via Supabase cron or app check
At least one price field (ARS or USD) must be provided on bids and lots
Company CUIT format validation: XX-XXXXXXXX-X (2 digits, dash, 8 digits, dash, 1 check digit)
Phone OTP codes expire after 60 seconds with max 3 attempts before 5-minute lockout
RLS policies: lots are readable by all authenticated users; bids are readable only by the frigorifico that placed them and the consignataria that owns the lot
Supabase Realtime subscriptions on lots (INSERT/UPDATE) and bids (INSERT/UPDATE) for live updates
Watchlist unique constraint: same user cannot save the same lot twice
Notifications are scoped to user_id — RLS prevents cross-company visibility

stories.title: Scaffold Next.js project with Supabase integration
stories.description: As a developer, I want to scaffold the Next.js project with Supabase client configuration so that we have a deployable foundation for FrigoConnect.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Next.js 14+ app with App Router and TypeScript strict mode: `npx create-next-app@latest frigoconnect --typescript --tailwind --eslint --app --src-dir`
Install core dependencies: `npm install @supabase/supabase-js @supabase/ssr`
Initialize shadcn/ui: `npx shadcn@latest init` with default config and install button + toast components: `npx shadcn@latest add button toast`
Install icon library: `npm install lucide-react`
Create `.env.local.example` with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY placeholder values
Create Supabase browser client at `src/lib/supabase/client.ts` using createBrowserClient
Create Supabase server client at `src/lib/supabase/server.ts` using createServerClient with cookie handling
Create root layout `src/app/layout.tsx` with `<html lang='es'>`, basic metadata (title: 'FrigoConnect', description in Spanish)
Create minimal landing page at `src/app/page.tsx` with 'FrigoConnect' heading, tagline 'Tu oferta de hacienda en una pantalla', and 'Iniciar sesión' link to /auth/login
Add scripts to package.json: `"lint": "next lint"`, `"typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"`
Example: `npm run dev` starts the app on localhost:3000 showing the landing page with heading and login link
Negative case: accessing `/dashboard` returns Next.js default 404 page (no authenticated routes exist yet)
`npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` pass with zero errors

stories.title: Database schema — companies, users, lots, bids, watchlist, notifications
stories.description: As a developer, I want to create the database schema in the shared Supabase project so that the app has the data foundation for all MVP features.
acceptanceCriteria: Install Supabase CLI as dev dependency: `npm install -D supabase`
Initialize local Supabase: `npx supabase init`
Create migration file with CREATE TABLE statements for: company, user_profile, lot, bid, watchlist_item, notification — all with columns, constraints, and CHECK enums as defined in the data model

Add foreign key relationships: user_profile.company_id → company.id, lot.consignataria_id → company.id, bid.lot_id → lot.id, bid.frigorifico_id → company.id, bid.user_id → user_profile.id, bid.parent_bid_id → bid.id (self-referencing, nullable)
Add UNIQUE constraint on watchlist_item(user_id, lot_id)
Enable Row Level Security (RLS) on all tables

RLS policies: lots SELECT for all authenticated users; bids SELECT only where frigorifico_id = user's company OR lot's consignataria_id = user's company; user_profile SELECT/UPDATE only for same company_id; company SELECT for all authenticated, UPDATE only for own company admins; watchlist_item full CRUD only for own user_id; notification SELECT/UPDATE only for own user_id

Create seed file with: 3 consignataria companies (with realistic names/provinces), 2 frigorífico companies, 10 lots (mix of breeds/categories/provinces/statuses), 5 bids (mix of statuses including one counter-offer chain)
Generate TypeScript types: `npx supabase gen types typescript --local > src/lib/supabase/database.types.ts`
Create typed Supabase client helper at `src/lib/supabase/typed-client.ts` that uses generated types
Example: querying lots table returns typed results with all fields; seed lot with breed='Angus', category='novillo', head_count=120, status='available' is present
Negative case: inserting a lot with category='cerdo' fails with CHECK constraint violation
Negative case: inserting a watchlist_item with duplicate (user_id, lot_id) fails with UNIQUE constraint
`npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` pass

stories.title: Phone OTP authentication — login flow
stories.description: As a frigorífico user, I want to log in with my phone number and a one-time code so that I can access the platform quickly without remembering passwords.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `/auth/login` page with phone number input field
Phone input accepts Argentine format with country code pre-filled (+54) and placeholder showing format: 11 1234-5678
Validate phone format on submit — show inline error 'Ingresá un número de teléfono válido' for invalid input
On valid submit, call Supabase `auth.signInWithOtp({ phone })` to send OTP code
After OTP sent, show 6-digit code input with 60-second countdown timer and disabled 'Reenviar código' button that enables after countdown
On successful OTP verification: if user has a user_profile record, redirect to `/dashboard`; if no profile exists, redirect to `/auth/registro`
Create Next.js middleware at `src/middleware.ts` that checks Supabase session on all routes except `/`, `/auth/*`, and `/_next/*` — redirect unauthenticated users to `/auth/login`
Store return URL in query param so user is redirected back after login
Example: user enters +54 11 1234-5678 → receives OTP → enters 6-digit code → lands on /dashboard (if profile exists) or /auth/registro (if new)
Negative case: entering wrong OTP 3 times shows 'Demasiados intentos. Intentá de nuevo en 5 minutos.' and disables input
Negative case: accessing `/feed` while logged out redirects to `/auth/login?returnTo=/feed`
`npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` pass

acceptanceCriteria: Create `/auth/registro` page accessible only to authenticated users who do NOT yet have a user_profile record
Multi-step wizard with progress indicator (3 steps: 1. Tus datos, 2. Tu empresa, 3. Operación)
Step 1 — Personal: full_name (required text input)

Step 2 — Company: name (required), CUIT (required, validate XX-XXXXXXXX-X format with check digit), provincia (dropdown with all 24 Argentine provinces), localidad (text), dirección (text), teléfono fijo (text), email (email input), web (url input)
Step 3 — Operations: capacity_heads_day (number input, optional), export_certified (checkbox, default unchecked)
Back button on steps 2 and 3 to return to previous step without losing data
On final submit: create company record (type='frigorifico'), create user_profile record (role='admin', phone from auth session), redirect to `/dashboard`
If CUIT already exists in database, show message: 'Esta empresa ya está registrada. Contactanos para solicitar acceso.' with a mailto link
Example: user fills all 3 steps with valid data → company and user_profile created → redirected to /dashboard with welcome state
Negative case: CUIT '99-99999999-9' with invalid check digit shows 'CUIT inválido — verificá el número'
Negative case: submitting step 2 without company name shows 'Este campo es obligatorio'
Negative case: user who already has a profile visiting /auth/registro is redirected to /dashboard
`npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` pass

stories.title: Place bid on a cattle lot
stories.description: As a frigorífico buyer (comprador or admin role), I want to place a bid on a cattle lot so that I can initiate a purchase negotiation with the consignatario.

Form fields: price offered in ARS/kg (required number input, show lot's asking price for reference), head count requested (number input, default = lot's full head_count, max = lot's head_count), message to consignatario (optional textarea, max 500 chars, placeholder 'Mensaje opcional para el consignatario...')

Check for existing active bid: if user's company has a bid with status='pending' on this lot, show message 'Ya tenés una oferta activa en este lote. Retirala antes de hacer otra.' with link to existing bid

Negative case: requesting 150 heads on a 120-head lot shows 'No podés solicitar más de 120 cabezas'

stories.title: Bid negotiation thread and counter-offer flow
stories.description: As a frigorífico buyer, I want to view the negotiation thread and respond to counter-offers so that I can negotiate towards a deal with the consignatario.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `/ofertas/[bidId]` page at `src/app/(app)/ofertas/[bidId]/page.tsx`
Fetch the full bid chain by following parent_bid_id references (recursive query or multiple fetches)

Display as chronological thread: each entry shows who made the offer (role label: 'Tu oferta' or consignatario company name), price offered (ARS/kg), head count, message if present, timestamp, status badge
Visual distinction: user's bids on right side (blue background), consignatario's on left side (gray background) — chat-style layout
Lot summary card pinned at top: breed, category, original head count, consignataria name, lot status
When latest bid in thread has status='countered' and was made by consignatario (not user's company), show 3 action buttons: 'Aceptar oferta' (green), 'Contraoferta' (orange), 'Rechazar' (red outline)

'Aceptar': confirmation dialog '¿Aceptar la oferta de $X/kg por Y cabezas?' → on confirm: update bid status to 'accepted', update lot status to 'sold', auto-reject all other pending bids on same lot. Show success: '¡Trato cerrado! 🤝'

'Contraoferta': opens bid form pre-filled with counter's price and head count for editing. On submit: creates new bid with parent_bid_id pointing to the counter-offer. Previous bid status stays 'countered'
'Rechazar': confirmation dialog '¿Rechazar esta oferta?' → update bid status to 'rejected'. Show toast 'Oferta rechazada'
When bid is in terminal state (accepted/rejected/expired), hide action buttons and show status banner
Example: seed data includes a counter-offer chain — thread displays 3 entries (initial bid → counter → counter) with correct alignment and action buttons on latest
Negative case: trying to accept an already-accepted bid shows 'Esta negociación ya fue cerrada'
Negative case: accessing a bid belonging to another company returns 'No tenés acceso a esta oferta'
`npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` pass

stories.description: As a frigorífico buyer, I want the feed and bid statuses to update in real-time so that I never miss new supply or counter-offers.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a custom React hook `useRealtimeSubscription` that wraps Supabase Realtime channel subscriptions with automatic cleanup on unmount
